method: Each of the four exact official photoFront JPEGs was directly retrieved and visually inspected before geometry changes. No bulk museum scraping.
sourcePhotoRedistribution: Original JPEGs are local inspection inputs only, not runtime assets and not included in this commit. URLs and SHA-256 hashes are retained for reproducibility.
sharedLimits: All dimensions are reversible visual fits, not measured.
Color is the inherited monochrome case material, not a photograph texture or detailed painted replica.
Local negative Z is the fitted front viewing convention, not verified compass direction.
Unseen rear ornament is not reconstructed.
All 16 case positions, enclosures, plinths and collisions remain unchanged.

supported: Tapered lower jar has its widest point near the upper shoulder.
A narrower raised crown has an open upper ring and uneven projecting front forms.
Several uneven applied forms lie on the visible shoulder.
fitted: All numeric radii, height fractions and front relief placements are visual fits.
The continuous neutral crown support is a conservative construction, not verified hidden anatomy.
Front relief is coarse, individually varied masses; no human/animal identities or iconography are claimed.
unknown: Rear ornament and interior crown construction.
Exact dimensions, collection identity and sculptural detail.

supported: Long neck ends in a flared cup-like mouth.

fitted: Profile, relief count/spacing, petal depth and curvature are visual fits.

unknown: Rear ornament, hidden openings and exact three-dimensional sculptural details.

supported: Bulbous body below a short wide cylindrical rim.
